hard_rules: city name must appear on every Pattern Lab thumbnail
real city photos/maps/documents must be used when source media exists
every visible line, arrow, box, redaction, label, and prop must have a declared click-purpose label
reference thumbnails are for anatomy benchmarking only; do not clone or trace them
AI support art is allowed only as non-proof support, never as source evidence
reference screenshots are private style/anatomy references only and must never be copied, traced, published, or used as proof media
thumbnail colors must feel vivid and alive, not bland, muddy, or overly dark
main title typography must feel premium/sexy/attention-grabbing at phone size, not generic system text
do not use public words such as SOURCE PHOTO, RECEIPT, SOURCE FILE, or generic proof labels unless the exact word creates viewer curiosity
redactions are allowed only when surrounded by readable meaningful words; bare black bars are blocked
prefer stunning city images, human stakes, dramatic subject scale, and bold red/yellow/white/black contrast when topic-appropriate
